016/**
017 * Returns CGM (Continuous Glucose Monitor) status.
018 *
019 * This is the CGMStatusB layout (see {@link CgmStatusV2Response}) with the sensor warmup
020 * durations appended.
021 *
022 * Binary layout (24 bytes total):
023 *   offset 0  (1 byte):  sessionState             - CGMStatusBState ordinal
024 *   offset 1  (4 bytes): lastCalibrationTimestamp - uint32, pump epoch seconds
025 *   offset 5  (4 bytes): sensorStartedTimestamp   - uint32, pump epoch seconds
026 *   offset 9  (1 byte):  transmitterBatteryStatus - TransmitterBatteryStatus ordinal
027 *   offset 10 (4 bytes): sessionDuration          - uint32, seconds
028 *   offset 14 (4 bytes): sessionTimeRemaining     - uint32, seconds
029 *   offset 18 (1 byte):  cgmSensorType            - CGMSensorType ordinal
030 *   offset 19 (1 byte):  gracePeriod              - nonzero = true
031 *   offset 20 (2 bytes): sensorWarmupDuration     - uint16, seconds
032 *   offset 22 (2 bytes): remainingWarmupDuration  - uint16, seconds
033 */
034
035/**

041 *
042 * This is the CGMStatusB layout (see {@link CgmStatusV2Response}) with the sensor warmup

044 *

051 *   offset 14 (4 bytes): sessionTimeRemaining     - uint32, seconds
052 *   offset 18 (1 byte):  cgmSensorType            - CGMSensorType ordinal
053 *   offset 19 (1 byte):  gracePeriod              - nonzero = true
054 *   offset 20 (2 bytes): sensorWarmupDuration     - uint16, seconds
055 *   offset 22 (2 bytes): remainingWarmupDuration  - uint16, seconds
056 *

077public class CGMStatusCResponse extends Message {
078
079    private int sessionStateId;
080    private SessionState sessionState;
081    private long lastCalibrationTimestamp;
082    private long sensorStartedTimestamp;
083    private int transmitterBatteryStatusId;
084    private TransmitterBatteryStatus transmitterBatteryStatus;
085    private long sessionDurationSeconds;
086    private long sessionTimeRemainingSeconds;
087    private int cgmSensorTypeId;
088    private CgmSensorType cgmSensorType;
089    private boolean gracePeriod;
090    private int sensorWarmupDurationSeconds;
091    private int remainingWarmupDurationSeconds;
092
093    public CGMStatusCResponse() {
094    }
095
096    public CGMStatusCResponse(
097            int sessionStateId,
098            long lastCalibrationTimestamp,
099            long sensorStartedTimestamp,
100            int transmitterBatteryStatusId,
101            long sessionDurationSeconds,
102            long sessionTimeRemainingSeconds,
103            int cgmSensorTypeId,
104            boolean gracePeriod,
105            int sensorWarmupDurationSeconds,
106            int remainingWarmupDurationSeconds) {
107        this.cargo = buildCargo(
108                sessionStateId,
109                lastCalibrationTimestamp,
110                sensorStartedTimestamp,
111                transmitterBatteryStatusId,
112                sessionDurationSeconds,
113                sessionTimeRemainingSeconds,
114                cgmSensorTypeId,
115                gracePeriod,
116                sensorWarmupDurationSeconds,
117                remainingWarmupDurationSeconds);
118        parse(this.cargo);
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * <table border="1">
123     * <caption>Parsed fields for CGMStatusCResponse:</caption>
124     * <tr><td><code>sessionStateId</code></td><td><code>raw[0] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
125     * <tr><td><code>sessionState</code></td><td><code>getSessionState()</code></td></tr>
126     * <tr><td><code>lastCalibrationTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 1)</code></td></tr>
127     * <tr><td><code>sensorStartedTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 5)</code></td></tr>
128     * <tr><td><code>transmitterBatteryStatusId</code></td><td><code>raw[9] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
129     * <tr><td><code>transmitterBatteryStatus</code></td><td><code>getTransmitterBatteryStatus()</code></td></tr>
130     * <tr><td><code>sessionDurationSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
131     * <tr><td><code>sessionTimeRemainingSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
132     * <tr><td><code>cgmSensorTypeId</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
133     * <tr><td><code>cgmSensorType</code></td><td><code>getCgmSensorType()</code></td></tr>
134     * <tr><td><code>gracePeriod</code></td><td><code>(raw[19] &amp; 0xFF) != 0</code></td></tr>
135     * <tr><td><code>sensorWarmupDurationSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
136     * <tr><td><code>remainingWarmupDurationSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
137     * </table>
138     */
139    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
140        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
141        this.cargo = raw;
142        this.sessionStateId = raw[0] & 0xFF;
143        this.sessionState = getSessionState();
144        this.lastCalibrationTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 1);
145        this.sensorStartedTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 5);
146        this.transmitterBatteryStatusId = raw[9] & 0xFF;
147        this.transmitterBatteryStatus = getTransmitterBatteryStatus();
148        this.sessionDurationSeconds = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
149        this.sessionTimeRemainingSeconds = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
150        this.cgmSensorTypeId = raw[18] & 0xFF;
151        this.cgmSensorType = getCgmSensorType();
152        this.gracePeriod = (raw[19] & 0xFF) != 0;
153        this.sensorWarmupDurationSeconds = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
154        this.remainingWarmupDurationSeconds = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * <table border="1">
159     * <caption>Byte layout for CGMStatusCResponse.buildCargo(...):</caption>
160     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
161     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) sessionStateId</code></td></tr>
162     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(lastCalibrationTimestamp) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
163     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(lastCalibrationTimestamp) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
164     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(lastCalibrationTimestamp) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
165     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(lastCalibrationTimestamp) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
166     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sensorStartedTimestamp) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
167     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sensorStartedTimestamp) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
168     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sensorStartedTimestamp) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
169     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>toUint32(sensorStartedTimestamp) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
170     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>(byte) transmitterBatteryStatusId</code></td></tr>
171     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionDurationSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
172     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionDurationSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
173     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionDurationSeconds) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
174     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionDurationSeconds) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
175     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionTimeRemainingSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
176     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionTimeRemainingSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
177     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionTimeRemainingSeconds) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
178     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toUint32(sessionTimeRemainingSeconds) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
179     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>(byte) cgmSensorTypeId</code></td></tr>
180     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>(byte) (gracePeriod ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
181     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(sensorWarmupDurationSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
182     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(sensorWarmupDurationSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
183     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(remainingWarmupDurationSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
184     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(remainingWarmupDurationSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
185     * </table>
186     */
187    public static byte[] buildCargo(
188            int sessionStateId,
189            long lastCalibrationTimestamp,
190            long sensorStartedTimestamp,
191            int transmitterBatteryStatusId,
192            long sessionDurationSeconds,
193            long sessionTimeRemainingSeconds,
194            int cgmSensorTypeId,
195            boolean gracePeriod,
196            int sensorWarmupDurationSeconds,
197            int remainingWarmupDurationSeconds) {
198        return Bytes.combine(
199                new byte[]{(byte) sessionStateId},
200                Bytes.toUint32(lastCalibrationTimestamp),
201                Bytes.toUint32(sensorStartedTimestamp),
202                new byte[]{(byte) transmitterBatteryStatusId},
203                Bytes.toUint32(sessionDurationSeconds),
204                Bytes.toUint32(sessionTimeRemainingSeconds),
205                new byte[]{(byte) cgmSensorTypeId},
206                new byte[]{(byte) (gracePeriod ? 1 : 0)},
207                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(sensorWarmupDurationSeconds),
208                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(remainingWarmupDurationSeconds));
209    }

211    public int getSessionStateId() {

213    }

222    /**
223     * CGM session states matching the Tandem app's CGMStatusBState enum ordinals.
224     */
225    public enum SessionState {
226        STATUS_STOPPED(0),
227        STATUS_START_PENDING(1),
228        SESSION_ACTIVE(2),
229        SESSION_STOP_PENDING(3),
230        UNKNOWN(4),
231        ;
232
233        private final int id;
234        SessionState(int id) {
235            this.id = id;
236        }
237
238        public static SessionState fromId(int id) {
239            for (SessionState s : values()) {
240                if (s.id == id) {
241                    return s;
242                }
243            }
244            return UNKNOWN;
245        }
246    }

254    }
255

258    }
